title: REQ · Admin round endpoints are mounted behind the admin token
summary: create, open, close, get and contributions routes require the admin token
description: Context: server.New registers POST /rounds, POST /rounds/{id}/open, POST /rounds/{id}/close, GET /rounds/{id} and GET /rounds/{id}/contributions inside r.Route("/api/v1/admin") with admin.Middleware(cfg.Admin.Token). Desired behavior: each route reaches its admin.RoundHandler method only with a valid bearer token. Expected result: unauthenticated calls get 401, authenticated calls reach the handler. Why: protects round control from the public.
acceptance_criteria: Given no Authorization header, when POST /api/v1/admin/rounds is called, then status is 401
Given Bearer tok and an existing round, when GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001 is called, then status is not 404

in_scope: Admin round route registration in server.New
preserve: Executions routes in the same admin group

definition_of_done: Five round routes registered in the admin group
